## How every exercise is solved {#method}

Each notebook follows the same discipline, established in the
[Preface](preface/index.qmd) case studies and kept throughout:

::: {.method-grid}
::: {.method-card}
<div class="method-icon">🔁</div>
<div class="method-name">Dual inference</div>

The classical parametric test or interval alongside a **randomization test,
bootstrap interval, or simulation** (10,000+ replicates, seed 2026). Where
the two disagree, the notebook says so — usually a signal of skewness or a
small sample.
:::

::: {.method-card}
<div class="method-icon">🧾</div>
<div class="method-name">Fully reproducible</div>

**Question → data → EDA → methods → decision**, with every figure and table
reproducible from the notebook itself, rendered on every push via GitHub
Pages, powered by Quarto and Jupyter.
:::

::: {.method-card}
<div class="method-icon">🗄️</div>
<div class="method-name">Archived data</div>

Datasets from [lock5stat.com](https://www.lock5stat.com/datasets3e/)
archived under `data/`; where the book prints only summary statistics, the
reconstruction is documented in the script docstrings.
:::
:::
